item.summary: Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare, Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda, today inaugurated and dedicated to the nation the Advanced Radiotherapy Facility at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Rajkot. Equipped with advanced radiation therapy technologies, the facility marks an important step towards improving access to specialised cancer care for people across Rajkot and the…
item.title: Union Health Minister Shri J.P. Nadda inaugurates Advanced Radiotherapy Facility at AIIMS Rajkot, reaffirms commitment to quality cancer care for every citizen
